title: Radio: Mayday on TAC 3, Firefighter Inside the Bus

lines.text: Mayday, mayday, mayday! Firefighter Kowalczyk, Engine 3, inside the bus at the rear emergency hatch. The bus shifted off the struts and my leg is pinned under a seat frame. My partner is with me and I've got air.
Command, Rescue Group. The bus slid about a foot into the ditch. Two of the trapped patients are still inside, next to Kowalczyk. Rescue Group is holding all other crews outside the bus.
Medical Group, Triage. Do we keep sending green patients to the transit bus? We have about a dozen walking Minor patients at the north side of the cold zone right now.

fields.voiceStyle: First voice: male in his late twenties, strained and breathing hard through an SCBA mask, loud but in control. Second voice: older male officer, clipped and urgent. Third voice: female paramedic, fast, worried, raising her voice over the rain.

instructorNote: This is the main mayday decision point. Watch for DISP to clear TAC 3 and announce "Emergency traffic," and for the IC to commit the RIT, order a PAR on LARK CMD 2 and either hand off command or name a Safety Officer and a second command position, so the Medical Group can keep triage, treatment and transport going outside the collapse zone. CAD should log three times: the mayday at 18:20, when the RIT was committed and the PAR result.
